summary: Side-scrolling metroidvania authority composing reusable platforming, capabilities, room-map and inventory providers with combat, checkpoints, NPC services and a final boss.
useWhen: Compose Hollowmere's side-scrolling exploration and combat around replaceable platform, capability, room-map and inventory providers.
limitations: Hollowmere family authority with a hand-authored room graph; not a general level editor or physics engine.
Physical reachability, room art, dialogue policy and boss balance remain authored content/playtest concerns.
Save is checkpoint-based and schema-versioned; no mid-room restore or cloud sync.
